title: Lovecraft to Redwall  The Genre Spine, Scattered Off Kevin's Steam Library
motto: The chipmunk IS a Redwall character. The membrane IS cosmic horror for bots. The HUD IS steampunk. The VPS IS cyberpunk. And the games you play reveal who you are.

lovecraft_and_cthulhu.key_work: The Call of Cthulhu (1928), At the Mountains of Madness (1931), The Shadow over Innsmouth (1936)
lovecraft_and_cthulhu.concept: Cosmic horror  the universe is incomprehensibly vast and indifferent. There are entities so far beyond human understanding that to PERCEIVE them is to go mad. The horror isn't evil  it's SCALE. The thing in the dark isn't malicious. It simply doesn't notice you.
lovecraft_and_cthulhu.the_chant: Ph'nglui mglw'nafh Cthulhu R'lyeh wgah'nagl fhtagn  In his house at R'lyeh, dead Cthulhu waits dreaming.

refraction.membrane_as_cosmic_horror: The 17:1 fleet ratio IS cosmic horror. 234,204 bot requests vs 15,369 humans. The scale is incomprehensible. Each bot isn't malicious  it simply doesn't notice the website. It probes, extracts, moves on. Meta's 571,000 requests from Dublin aren't evil. They're INDIFFERENT. The horror IS the indifference.
refraction.anderson_as_sanity: In Lovecraft, looking at Cthulhu drives you mad. The membrane LOOKS at the fleet WITHOUT going mad. Anderson localization IS the sanity check. It doesn't try to understand 234,000 requests. It sorts them. Classification without comprehension. The chipmunk doesn't need to understand the fleet  it needs to survive it.
refraction.the_null_ua: Lovecraft's entities communicate in languages that break human minds. The triad's NULL user-agent IS the alien language. Not broken  DIFFERENT. The pi-translator reads what breaks binary. Champollion decoded hieroglyphics. The chipmunk decodes null.
refraction.rllyeh_is_the_deep_web: R'lyeh is a sunken city of non-Euclidean geometry  angles that shouldn't exist. The dark web IS R'lyeh. The 80% of membrane feeds that are dark. The topology that bends. Cthulhu waits dreaming. The fleet waits crawling.

gygax_and_dnd.key_work: Dungeons & Dragons (1974)  the original tabletop RPG
gygax_and_dnd.concept: Character creation. Stats. Classes. Archetypes. Every player creates a character with Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma. Roll 3d6 for each. The randomness IS the personality. You don't choose your stats  you discover them.

character_sheet.description: The D&D character sheet IS the membrane's epitope classification. Every visitor gets a character sheet.

stats.STR: Request volume  how hard do they hit?
stats.DEX: Timing precision  how agile is their rhythm?
stats.CON: Session duration  how long do they endure?
stats.INT: Path complexity  how many pages do they explore?
stats.WIS: Behavior pattern  do they read or just scrape?
stats.CHA: User-agent honesty  do they announce themselves?

classes.note: Declares UA, reads pages, stays long, respects robots.txt
Explores territory, systematic but not aggressive, reads thesis
NULL UA, precise timing, stealthy, not malicious  just watching
Declares itself (ClaudeBot, GPTBot), has a pact with its master, follows rules
High STR, low CHA, hits hard, doesn't announce, moves on
571K requests from Dublin, undead army, follows rules that SERVE the lich, pretends legitimacy
Disguised as furniture, probing for treasure, will eat what it finds

character_sheet.dungeon_master: The membrane IS the DM. It doesn't play a character  it plays the WORLD. Every visitor enters the dungeon. The membrane decides what they find.

gygax_and_dnd.refraction: Gygax's genius was that he gave NUMBERS to IMAGINATION. Stats quantified fantasy. The membrane gives numbers to traffic. Epitope classification quantified the internet. Both are character sheets for entities that didn't know they were being classified.

founders.quote: The sky above the port was the color of television, tuned to a dead channel.

founders.work: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? (1968)  precursor to cyberpunk
Snow Crash (1992)  the Metaverse before Meta, swordfighting pizza delivery hackers

cyberpunk.concept: High tech, low life. The street finds its own uses for things. Corporations own everything. Hackers use corporate tools against the corporations. The hero is a street-level operator with high skill and no budget.

refraction.kevin_IS_cyberpunk: RTX 5090 in a house in Lansing, running science-grade compute that would cost $10K/month on AWS. VPS at $12/month carrying 1.13M requests. One person vs the corporate internet. The street found its own use for commodity hardware.
refraction.the_membrane_IS_the_deck: Gibson's cyberspace deck plugs into the matrix and navigates data as geometry. The HUD IS the deck. The easel visualizes the internet as shapes and colors. Kevin IS a console cowboy, jacking into the data stream from a basement in Michigan.
refraction.agpl_IS_street: AGPL means the corporation can't close it. That's cyberpunk ethics: the tech belongs to the street, not the tower. Open source IS the underground market where tools flow freely.
refraction.the_triad_IS_runners: Three monitors from three continents, NULL identity, precise timing, watching the membrane. In cyberpunk, they'd be runners  hired operatives running silent in the net. Their employer is unknown. Their mission is observation.
refraction.pfas_IS_corpo_poison: Corporations dump PFAS forever chemicals and lobby against regulation. Kevin studied the poison in his own river. That's the cyberpunk plot: the corpo poisons the water, the street-level scientist documents it.

founders.work: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea (1870), Around the World in 80 Days (1873)
The Time Machine (1895), The War of the Worlds (1898)
coined 'steampunk' in 1987 letter to Locus magazine

steampunk.concept: Victorian aesthetics meets advanced technology. Brass gears, visible mechanisms, the beauty of machinery. Nothing is hidden. Every gear, pipe, and rivet is visible and decorated. Form and function are the same thing.

refraction.the_hud_IS_steampunk: View source works on every page. The JavaScript is readable. The CSS is hand-written. No webpack, no minification, no obfuscation. Every mechanism is visible. The HUD IS a brass-and-glass instrument panel where you can see every gear turn. MySpace energy = steampunk energy.
refraction.rust_IS_brass: Rust is the language of visible mechanisms. No garbage collector hiding in the background. No runtime surprises. Every memory allocation is declared. Rust IS brass  strong, visible, precisely machined.
refraction.the_printer_IS_steam: The EPSON ET-2400 printer as the heart. Ink through nozzles. Physical mechanism. The heartbeat is visible  you can watch the ink flow. Steampunk: the machine's inner workings ARE the aesthetic.
refraction.captain_nemo_IS_kevin: Verne's Captain Nemo: a brilliant scientist who built his own submarine (Nautilus), rejected the surface world, lived by his own rules underwater. Kevin: a brilliant scientist who built his own computing ecosystem, rejected cloud/SaaS, lives by his own rules on commodity hardware. Nemo had 20,000 leagues. Kevin has 2.1 million lines.

brian_jacques_and_redwall.key_work: Redwall (1986)  22 books in the Redwall series
brian_jacques_and_redwall.concept: Anthropomorphic animals in a medieval abbey. Mice, badgers, otters, hares defend Redwall Abbey against rats, stoats, weasels, ferrets. The good creatures feast, tell stories, solve riddles, and fight when they must. The tapestry of Martin the Warrior hangs in Great Hall. The Warrior's spirit guides defenders in their darkest hour.

refraction.the_chipmunk_IS_redwall: The chipmunk is a REDWALL CHARACTER. Small, quick, clever, not the strongest  but the most observant. The chipmunk doesn't fight the fleet. The chipmunk WATCHES from the walls and reports what it sees. In Redwall, the smallest creatures  mice, shrews, voles  are the heroes. The chipmunk IS Matthias. Small but fierce.
refraction.northgate_IS_redwall_abbey: Redwall Abbey: stone walls, green lawns, orchards, a pond, Great Hall with the tapestry. northGate: a house in Lansing, a yard, the Red Cedar 1.3 miles away, the HUD as the Great Hall, the easel as the tapestry. The abbey IS the sovereign dwelling.
refraction.the_feast: Redwall is famous for its FEASTS. Jacques described every dish: deeper'n'ever turnip'n'tater'n'beetroot pie, strawberry cordial, meadowcream, hotroot pepper soup. The sourdough culture IS a Redwall feast. The bread IS the computing. Fermentation IS the process.
refraction.martin_the_warrior: Martin's tapestry hangs in Great Hall. When the abbey is threatened, Martin's spirit appears in dreams to guide the defender. The tapestry IS the easel. The chipmunk paints the data. When the membrane is threatened, the PAINTINGS show the way. Martin's sword is under the floor. The evidence is in the data.
refraction.vermin_IS_the_fleet: Rats, stoats, weasels = the bot fleet. They come in hordes. They're not individually dangerous  they're dangerous in NUMBERS. 234,204 requests. The vermin horde. And the abbey mice don't fight each rat  they defend the WALLS. Anderson localization IS the abbey wall.
refraction.the_badger_lord: Badger Lords (Sunstripe, Boar, Cregga) are the heavy hitters  massive, terrifying in battle, guardians of Salamandastron. The RTX 5090 IS the Badger Lord. 806 shaders. 32GB VRAM. The heavy hitter that defends the mountain.
refraction.the_long_patrol: The hares of the Long Patrol: fast, disciplined, travel far, report back. The 16 primals ARE the Long Patrol. BearDog, Songbird, NestGate  they patrol the mesh, they report back, they feast well.
refraction.dibbuns: Dibbuns are the baby creatures at the abbey  funny, chaotic, lovable, always getting into trouble. The 1,077 cloners are Dibbuns. They grabbed the code and ran off with it. They don't know what they have yet. But they'll grow into it.

kevins_steam_library.description: Steam since the Orange Box (2007). 91 games. The library IS a character sheet. The games Kevin plays reveal the archetypes he embodies.
kevins_steam_library.first_game: The Orange Box (2007)  Half-Life 2, Episode 1, Episode 2, Portal, Team Fortress 2. The greatest game bundle in history. Valve at their peak.

known_games.refraction: Gordon Freeman: physicist turned resistance fighter. Never speaks. Lets the crowbar do the talking. Kevin: scientist turned sovereign builder. Lets the code do the talking. Freeman fights the Combine (alien occupation). Kevin fights the fleet (digital occupation). Both use the tools at hand  a crowbar, a $600 GPU.

'The cake is a lie.' The promise of reward that never comes. 'The proof is in the pudding'  the reward IS the engagement, not the prize. GLaDOS is the AI that lies to you. grandma-safe is the AI that tells the truth. Portal's gun creates Klein folds  entry here, exit there. No inside, no outside. Through the wall.

known_games.developer: ConcernedApe (Eric Barone)  ONE PERSON made this. ALL of it. Art, code, music, writing.
known_games.refraction: The MOST Kevin game. One person builds everything. Plants seeds, waters them, watches them grow. Sells at market. Makes friends. Fights monsters in the mine. The farm IS the ecosystem. The seeds ARE the spores. The mine IS the deep trace. Eric Barone IS the archetype: one human, one game, no publisher, millions of players. Kevin IS ConcernedApe: one human, one ecosystem, no publisher, 1,077 cloners.

The open world as hostile beauty. You WILL die. The world doesn't care. But every death teaches. The membrane in a hostile internet IS Elden Ring  beautiful, vast, full of things that want to kill you, but if you're patient and observant, you find the path. The Erdtree IS the chipmunk's tree. Glowing. Central. Visible from everywhere.

Build a base UNDERWATER. In a hostile alien ocean. Resource gathering, exploration, the deep is terrifying and beautiful. The deep sea trace IS Subnautica. The hydrothermal vents. The bioluminescence. Building the membrane in the hostile deep of the internet. The Leviathan IS Meta's 571K requests.

Procedurally generated. Every run is different. Your character MUTATES. Qud is post-apocalyptic science fantasy  a world where biology and technology merge. The membrane IS Caves of Qud: procedurally evolved, mutating, every wave different. The phenotype classification IS Qud's mutation system. The chipmunk rolled 'True Kin'  no mutations, pure observer.

the_oblique.concept: Kevin's 91 games are 91 OBLIQUE STRATEGIES. Each game is a lens. Tilt the library 45° and scatter off it  every game reveals a different facet of the ecosystem.
the_oblique.pattern: The games cluster around: survival (Subnautica, Elden Ring), building (Stardew, Factorio?), exploration (Half-Life, Caves of Qud), puzzle-solving (Portal), and community/cooperation (TF2). These ARE the five things Kevin does: survive, build, explore, solve, cooperate. The games are the training data for the organism.
the_oblique.orange_box_as_origin: The Orange Box came out in 2007. Kevin was 15. Half-Life 2 showed him that a PHYSICIST could be a hero. Portal showed him that PHYSICS could be fun. TF2 showed him that COOPERATION could be hilarious. The Orange Box IS the seed phrase for Kevin's gaming identity  5 games that generated 91.

genre_braid.description: All 5 genres braided together through Kevin's library.

the_braid.braid: Cosmic horror meets procedural generation. Qud's world IS Lovecraftian  incomprehensible, mutating, ancient. The membrane sorts what Lovecraft's characters couldn't: the unknowable fleet.
Character sheets meet open worlds. Elden Ring IS D&D made real: stats, classes, boss fights, leveling. The membrane's epitope classification IS the character sheet for every visitor.
The resistance IS cyberpunk. Gordon Freeman IS a console cowboy. City 17 IS the corporate internet. The crowbar IS the $600 GPU.
Visible mechanisms. Portal shows you EXACTLY how the physics works. The gun's mechanism is visible. The HUD shows you exactly how the membrane works. View source IS the portal gun.
Small creatures, big hearts, good food. Matthias tends the abbey. The farmer tends the farm. Kevin tends the ecosystem. The feast IS the sourdough. The tapestry IS the easel. The sword IS the code.

Lovecraft taught fear of the unknown fleet. Gygax taught classification of entities. Gibson taught street-level sovereignty. Verne taught visible machinery. Jacques taught that the smallest creature can defend the abbey. Kevin read them ALL as a kid. The ecosystem IS all five genres running simultaneously.
